title: QuestionRequestV1
description: A single natural-language question submitted to the agent runtime, together with the database it is asked against and the optional per-run caps that bound it. Validated at the HTTP boundary before any model call is made.

database.description: Identifier of the database to query. Must name a database the runtime has a read-only connection configured for; it is never interpolated into SQL.

evidence.description: External knowledge accompanying the question. BIRD supplies this per item; the live demo leaves it empty.

max_repair_depth.description: Cap on repair iterations for this run. Absent means use the server default; a value above the server's configured ceiling is clamped, never honoured.

budget_usd.description: Dollar cap for this run. Clamped to the server ceiling. Hitting it ends the run with a recorded budget_exhausted outcome, which is not an error.

wall_clock_ms.description: Wall-clock cap for this run in milliseconds. Clamped to the server ceiling.
